source_row.rationale: Tachycardia, hypotension, and increased sanguineous (bloody) drainage from a surgical site are classic signs of post-operative hemorrhage, a potentially serious complication requiring immediate further assessment (vital signs, wound/dressing inspection, possible lab work), prompt provider notification, and intervention to prevent hypovolemic shock.
source_row.source_detail: Postoperative hemorrhage: increasing sanguineous drainage plus tachycardia/hypotension; source reviewed 2026-08-14.
source_row.source_name: AORN — Postoperative Hemorrhage Recognition and Management
